focus: Truck-rental desks in San Francisco (SoMa, the Mission, Bayview, Ingleside, the Outer Sunset, Parkmerced, Treasure Island) and just south of the line in Daly City and South San Francisco — three company-run U-Haul stores, nine U-Haul neighborhood dealers, and two Penske locations — plus three labor-only options
intro: This first San Francisco page covers truck-rental locations whose official U-Haul and Penske pages list addresses in San Francisco or just south of the city line: three company-run U-Haul stores (Bryant St in SoMa, Valencia St near Market, and Bayshore Blvd by Candlestick) that all publish Sunday hours and stay open until 7:00 PM on weekdays (8:00 PM Fridays), five U-Haul neighborhood dealers in the city (Ingleside, the Outer Sunset, Parkmerced, Treasure Island, and Bayview) and four in Daly City — Halloway Market on Holloway Ave lists 9:00 AM–7:00 PM on weekdays and Sunday hours — plus the Penske desk in Bayview, whose weekday hours end at 2:00 PM, and the Penske branch in South San Francisco, which lists Sunday morning hours. Three labor-only options are included for people who already have a truck or container: Bellhop, CareMore Moving & Storage, and Royal Moving & Storage; none publishes a dollar rate on the pages we checked. Budget Truck Rental, Enterprise Truck Rental, Home Depot rental desks, Oakland locations, and other U-Haul dealers are not covered yet; one Daly City dealer that lists itself closed through December 31 was left out. The company-run U-Haul stores list 7:00 AM–3:00 PM on December 24 and closed on December 25, and several dealers list extra closures around Thanksgiving weekend and the holidays. We do not report live truck counts; one-way and cargo-van flags are on only when the location page itself mentions them.

listings.name: Bellhop — San Francisco hourly moving labor
listings.area: SoMa office · New Montgomery St (serves San Francisco)
listings.address: 149 New Montgomery St., San Francisco, CA 94105

hours.notes: Hours from the footer of the official San Francisco page: Mon–Sat 8:00 AM to 10:00 PM EST, Sun 8:00 AM to 10:00 PM EST (Eastern time, which is 5:00 AM–7:00 PM Pacific).

listings.offersNotes: The official San Francisco page offers “Hourly moving help and labor”: “If you don’t need transportation but could use some moving help, Bellhop’s skilled San Francisco movers make quick work of loading, unloading, and/or rearranging,” including packing a storage unit into a truck. The same page says Bellhop is a federally regulated property broker that connects customers with independent labor and/or transportation providers.
listings.visitNotes: Bellhop describes itself as a broker, so the crew may be a partner mover. Book online or by phone and confirm crew availability for your date.

listings.name: CareMore Moving & Storage — labor-only moves

hours.notes: The labor-only page says “SF-based crews, 7am–7pm” but does not say which days, so day-by-day hours are left as not published. Call to confirm weekend crews.

listings.offersNotes: The official labor-only page says crews load or unload “your rental truck, POD, container,” including U-Haul, Penske, Sprinter, POD, or storage unit, and that labor-only is crew and equipment without a truck. Licensed and insured per the page (CAL-T 0190970).
listings.visitNotes: Request a slot by phone or the quote form; the page says it provides a free quote after a virtual or in-person tour and coordinates COIs, elevator windows, and loading zones.
listings.feeNotes: The page says a short hourly minimum applies and is spelled out in the estimate. No dollar rates are published on that page.
